subcircuits.netlist:
.subckt pmos_bias_reference_generator iref_snk vdd
M1 iref_snk iref_snk vdd vdd pmos l=l_cs_p w=w_cs_p*1 m=1 nf=1
.ends pmos_bias_reference_generator
subcircuits.role_hint: Bias generation network using diode-connected PMOS M1 to establish the PMOS current-source gate bias iref_snk for M2 and M5.

subcircuits.netlist:
.subckt error_amplifier_input_gain_stage gnd iref_snk vdd vin fb net7
M4 net7 vin net5 vdd pmos l=l_eai_p w=w_eai_p*1 m=1 nf=1 sd=220.0n
M3 net6 fb net5 vdd pmos l=l_eai_p w=w_eai_p*1 m=1 nf=1 sd=220.0n
M2 net5 iref_snk vdd vdd pmos l=l_cs_p w=w_cs_p*1 m=1 nf=1
M8 net6 net6 gnd gnd nmos l=l_eal_n w=w_eal_n*1 m=1 nf=1 sd=220.0n
M7 net7 net6 gnd gnd nmos l=l_eal_n w=w_eal_n*1 m=1 nf=1 sd=220.0n
.ends error_amplifier_input_gain_stage
subcircuits.role_hint: Core error-amplifier input/gain stage. M2 provides PMOS bias current, M3/M4 form the PMOS differential input pair comparing fb against vin, and M7/M8 form the NMOS current-mirror active load producing the amplifier output at net7.

subcircuits.netlist:
.subckt pmos_gate_driver_stage gnd iref_snk vdd net7 net2
M6 gnd net7 net2 vdd pmos l=l_eab_p w=w_eab_p*1 m=1 nf=1 sd=220.0n
M5 net2 iref_snk vdd vdd pmos l=l_cs_p w=w_cs_p*1 m=1 nf=1
.ends pmos_gate_driver_stage
subcircuits.role_hint: Second gain / gate-driver stage. M5 supplies biased pull-up current from vdd, while M6 senses the error-amplifier output net7 and drives net2, the PMOS pass-device gate-control node.

subcircuits.netlist:
.subckt pmos_pass_output_feedback_stage gnd vdd net2 vo fb
M0 vo net2 vdd vdd pmos l=l_power_p w=w_power_p*1 m=1 nf=1
R1 vo fb res r1
R2 fb gnd res r2
.ends pmos_pass_output_feedback_stage
subcircuits.role_hint: LDO output power stage and feedback sensing network. M0 is the PMOS pass transistor controlled by net2, while R1/R2 divide the regulated output vo to generate the feedback voltage fb for the error amplifier.

subcircuits.netlist:
.subckt miller_frequency_compensation_network net7 vo
R0 net1 vo res r0
C0 net7 net1 cap c0
.ends miller_frequency_compensation_network
subcircuits.role_hint: Frequency compensation network. C0 in series with R0 couples the error-amplifier output node net7 to the regulator output vo through internal node net1, providing Miller/zero compensation for loop stability.

subcircuits.netlist:
.subckt output_load_capacitor vo GND
CL vo GND cap cload
.ends output_load_capacitor
subcircuits.role_hint: Output load capacitor connected from the regulated output vo to GND, representing the LDO load capacitance and contributing to output filtering and loop dynamics.
